data.name: Lisa and Steve
data.headline: Custom Word Art
data.description:
I just wanted to thank you for your never ending patience and personal attention to our project. We are beyond thrilled with the products you produced for us. Just when we thought we would be incredibly limited having to comply with a Class A building, your company showed us just how creative we can be. I am sending you a picture of the front of our venue. We wish we could share more, but being escape room games, we are sworn to secrecy within the confines of our walls. :-)

Thank you again for making the process painless. We love your products and will definitely recommend Magic Murals to anyone who is in need of such a product. We are so pleased and want to share with you our gratitude.'

data.name: Francis W.
data.headline: A Wonderful Tribute
data.description:
One of my best friends passed away last year and I was recently allowed to have her antique window. It was one of my favorite pieces of hers. I repainted the wood and searched online for a company that had something which would resemble a bit of heaven to stick behind it so that I could picture her there every time I looked at this window.

I am so pleased with your company's murals and it fit perfectly behind the window. I have used other wall murals in the past and they are very difficult to separate from the backing, and the material is flimsy. For this particular project I did not apply this mural directly to my wall. I felt that it would be easier to center it to the frame by attaching it behind the window directly and it holds up very well!

I did notice that the material in your company's murals is a lot more durable and is easy to separate, and for this it would be easier to work with when applying to the wall.

The customer service is great and the delivery of the product to my home was very fast, which I really appreciated. Thank you so much for your services.'

data.name: George G.
data.headline: Driving To the Ocean
data.description:
Just wanted to show you how the installation came out. We live in the desert SW and this was the image that popped for my wife when I was showing her ideas for the wall. We recently added on. Since I knew we would be doing a mural, I had the construction people finish the wall without texture. It came out great. I installed while she was on a trip and she loves it! It's just a lot of fun. Coming home and rolling into the garage parking place is always delightful.

Thank you for a great product and for great service!'

data.headline: Beautiful Venice
data.description:
I went on line and found your company. When I called, your customer service was so pleasant, informative and helpful. I was so excited to receive my mural. I couldn't wait to put it up.

I live in a split level home. I measured the entire wall above my main entry door. It fits wall to wall, door to ceiling. It makes you feel like you can touch the water.

I am so pleased. I would definitely recommend your company to all that ask about it. Thank you.'

data.name: Glenn T.
data.headline: Visit California
data.description:
We live in Orange, CA and had not only had a difficult time finding large format art work, but we wanted something that made a statement about where we live. The 'California Oranges' mural fit the need.

My wife and I mounted this to 1/4in plywood with a 1x2 wood to thicken the back edges in order to turn this mural into a 'canvas' like thickness.

We were pleased with the quality of the mural material, quickness in delivery, and it was shipped in sturdy packaging to prevent damage. This mural now decorates a large family room wall. Exactly what we were looking for.'

data.name: Greg B.
data.headline: The Real Men's Room
data.description:
I enjoyed looking at all of the murals on line and ordering was a snap. Their customer service was great. I had a deadline and also had a custom mural made for my small 2 car garage.

My painter and I prepared the wall surface smooth and together was able to get the mural up in just an hour or more. We took our time and lined it up just right and removed any small bubbles that may have been in there.

I found working with this product was easy and put up the smaller mural in my shop men's restroom myself. My painter added a small trim on the outside which really added the pop!

In my shop I wanted a mural that went with my cars so I chose just the right brick. In fact, Debbie in customer service helped me find what I told her on the phone that I wanted, and since it was going to be used in a shop, Debbie made sure that I got just the right one!

I am so happy with my choices and would order from them a 4th time if I have a need. The prices were very fair as well, and the shipping was quick. I would rate my experience 5 stars with Magic Murals!'

data.headline: I'd Rather Be Golfing
data.description:
My home office was a much smaller room then in my former house. I ordered the Lahinch golf mural in the large size. I had the opportunity to play this course several times and as an avid golfer, love the Irish courses.

The UltraStikﾙ was very easy to put up by myself and I absolutely love it.

As you can see by the picture, my small office is now my favorite place to work and even visit when the weather outside is not suitable for me playing golf. The quality is excellent and I would recommend it to any one.'
